en.title: Solutions developer
en.description: I solve problems with systems, data and tools.
en.interests: I dig into systems, architecture, data, Linux and tools for developers.
en.learning: I study computing, art, literature and mathematics. Different angles help me see a problem whole.
personalInterests: Learning how computing and science work internally and how to build things independently.

trajectory.organization: Central de Vagas em Creches — IFRO
highlights: Worked on the backend, public portal, dashboard and reports alongside other developers, under the project coordinator.
Stayed with it through rollout, until municipal public-sector teams were running on it.
Structured the academic domain with hexagonal architecture and CQRS, keeping business rules independent of infrastructure.
Worked out recurrence modelling and transactional journal creation, so a partial failure never leaves the data inconsistent.
Delivered a theme, content types and filters built to fit an institutional portal rather than force it into a template.
Containerized the environment and automated deployment, taking releases out of a manual process.

trajectory.organization: Central de Vagas em Creches — IFRO

trajectory.role: Desenvolvedor backend em projeto open source
highlights: Estruturei o domínio acadêmico com arquitetura hexagonal e CQRS, mantendo as regras de negócio independentes da infraestrutura.
Resolvi a modelagem de recorrência e a criação transacional de diários, para que uma falha parcial nunca deixe os dados inconsistentes.
Entreguei tema, tipos de conteúdo e filtros sob medida para o portal institucional, em vez de forçá-lo dentro de um modelo pronto.
Conteinerizei o ambiente e automatizei a implantação, tirando as publicações do processo manual.
